description: This source file defines the EmployeeService interface, which declares methods for managing Employee objects, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion.

classes.name: EmployeeService
classes.description: Interface for employee management operations within the domain layer.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee object based on the provided employee ID.

methods.name: createEmployee
methods.description: Creates a new Employee record based on the provided Employee object.

methods.name: updateEmployee
methods.description: Updates an existing Employee record with information from the provided Employee object.

methods.name: deleteEmployee
methods.description: Deletes the Employee record associated with the specified employee ID.
